what: Track record of the stock page's Technicals gauge: change over the next 10 and 63 trading days compared with the average sampled stock on the same day, by the gauge's label.
method: model E's 464 stocks with at least 470 sessions of prices; the label from the page's own code (chart-indicators.js) on the last 400 sessions up to each close, every 5th session; 95% intervals from day-level averages, widened for overlapping windows. Before costs; companies listed today only.

verdict_10.Strongly bearish: did worse than the average stock
verdict_10.Bearish: did worse than the average stock
verdict_10.Neutral: no measurable difference from the average stock
verdict_10.Bullish: no measurable difference from the average stock
verdict_10.Strongly bullish: no measurable difference from the average stock
